component: MIME header collection API and compose callers

quotes.text: Retrieve an enumerator of the names of all headers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: headerNames returns Array<AUTF8String>, and MimeStructuredHeaders creates it by copying its Map keys. The extension can call flatMap directly and MimeMessage can iterate the returned array without a second spread. Snapshot behavior now belongs to that getter; do not remove copies from unrelated producers by analogy. The IDL's Retrieve an enumerator wording is stale and should describe the array while keeping its header-case caveat. No MIME or extension test ran.
title: Structured header names are eager arrays despite the retained enumerator wording
